messages.content:
Three independent readers read the same non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and decided whether it supports one statement (the hypothesis). They may agree or disagree, and a program has checked each of their quotes against the document. Your job is to make the final decision yourself, from the document.

<document>
<document 51 omitted, sha256 b22a7a30523ef437>
</document>

<hypothesis>
Receiving Party shall not disclose the fact that Agreement was agreed or negotiated.
</hypothesis>

<readings>
<reading id="A">
label: Entailment
confidence: 88
reason: Clause 1(a) states that information includes the identity of the Parties, the contents of the agreement and the fact that they have entered into it, all treated as confidential, which covers disclosure of the fact the agreement was agreed or negotiated.
<quote check="exact">the contents of this agreement and the fact that they have entered into this Agreement</quote>
<quote check="exact">The Parties are entering into data sharing negotiations</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="B">
label: Entailment
confidence: 88
reason: The fact of entering into the Agreement is defined as confidential Information, so the receiving Party is bound to keep it confidential, which implies no disclosure of it.
<quote check="exact">Information shall also include the identity of the Parties, the contents of this agreement and the fact that they have entered into this Agreement.</quote>
<quote check="exact">The receiving Party undertakes not to use the Information disclosed to it for any purpose except the Purpose.</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="C">
label: Entailment
confidence: 85
reason: The fact that the Parties entered into the Agreement is defined as confidential Information, so the receiving Party may not disclose it beyond what the Purpose requires.
<quote check="exact">Information shall also include the identity of the Parties, the contents of this agreement and the fact that they have entered into this Agreement.</quote>
</reading>
</readings>

The readings are evidence about where to look, not votes: a majority can be wrong, and a quote marked "missing" was not found in the document. Read the relevant parts of the document yourself.

Choose exactly one label:
- Entailment: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is false.
- NotMentioned: the document does not address the hypothesis, or says too little to decide.

Evidence is required. For Entailment or Contradiction, give 1 to 3 quotes copied character for character from the document (no paraphrase, no ellipses), each as short as it can be while still carrying the point. They will be checked against the document. For NotMentioned, give an empty list.

Give a confidence from 0 to 100: your probability, in percent, that your label is correct. Give a one-sentence reason.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: label, confidence, quotes, reason.

content.text: {"label": "Entailment", "confidence": 85, "quotes": ["Information shall also include the identity of the Parties, the contents of this agreement and the fact that they have entered into this Agreement.", "only on a need to know basis and only to the extent absolutely necessary for the Purpose"], "reason": "The fact that the Parties entered into the Agreement is defined as confidential Information, which may be disclosed only on a need-to-know basis for the Purpose, so the receiving Party may not otherwise disclose it."}
